transport: Official existing Go SDK Streamable HTTP, JSON-only, request-scoped/sessionless; no persistent SSE or resumable output
discovery: Only current credential allowed tools; descriptions static; no module/user/source names in tool registry
output: Use protocol.mcp_wire for exact HTTP/JSON-RPC/isError/carrier mapping. Tool business failures are explicit isError:true with matching closed Error envelope in both carriers; transport/protocol errors have no tool result. Measure the complete JSON-RPC response<=1MiB.
authentication: Restricted bearer only, on every transport request and tool invocation; session IDs/cache never authorize. No X-Knowledge-MCP-Profile required on the new endpoint.
not_offered: forwarding tokens to native API or external services

wire_error_mapping.profile: Existing protocol versions2025-11-25/2025-06-18 and current Go SDKv1.8.0; no2026 protocol upgrade. This is managed bearer, not OAuth discovery.
dispatch_priority: current bearer authentication (and parent liveness) before SDK dispatch
closed owning tool arguments and operation business checks
fresh final authentication/authorization and bounded response release

rows.case: Missing/invalid/revoked/expired credential or invalid current parent authority, before dispatch OR detected at final gate
rows.jsonrpc: No result or JSON-RPC error carrier
rows.headers: WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="knowledge-access",error="invalid_token"; no-store; do not advertise nonexistent OAuth metadata

rows.case: Invalid Origin or independently forbidden transport admission for an otherwise known principal
rows.headers: no-store; no OAuth scope escalation; tool action insufficiency is handled below, not by this row

rows.case: Authentication/final authentication DB unavailable; validity cannot be established
Body>32768 bytes / unsupported content-type / invalid Accept or protocol header / malformed JSON,batch,invalid RPC outer request
rows.jsonrpc: No tool result. Preserve current selected SDK transport rejection; use fixed bounded diagnostic/no echoed body.
rows.body: Fixed transport diagnostic only; no business data,structuredContent or text result

rows.case: Well-formed tools/call to unknown or unavailable tool, including search under read-only registry
rows.body: Official SDK invalid-params error with safe generic message; no structuredContent/text business carrier

rows.case: Known RPC method but malformed CallToolParams at SDK protocol decoding
rows.body: Official protocol invalid-params error; no operation data

rows.case: Unsupported RPC method under the selected2025 legacy HTTP transport
rows.jsonrpc: Current GoSDK checkRequest rejects before dispatch; do not claim every such request returns JSON-RPC -32601
rows.body: Fixed bounded transport diagnostic. This differs from the SDK2026 HTTP404/MethodNotFound branch, which is not selected here.

rows.case: Known registered tool: arguments fail the application closed DTO or semantic validation
rows.body: Matching operation Error envelope code=invalid_request,data:null in structuredContent and one JSON text carrier

rows.case: Known registered tool: live credential but read-only view used for search / inaccessible item / own expired view / dependency not closed / stale publication / business data DB error
rows.body: Matching operation Error envelope action_denied/not_found/view_stale/scope_not_supported/index_stale/unavailable,data:null; never mirror the native HTTP403/404/409/503 into this tool-result status

rows.case: Credential expires/revokes/loses authority during a tool call
rows.body: Use first row,not a success-shaped tool result. A later request also401. A view alone expiring while credential remains valid instead uses tool result view_stale above.

rows.case: Business response/complete encoded JSON-RPC result exceeds1MiB or output schema invalid
rows.jsonrpc: Replace entire planned result with a small fixed tool failure, preserving only a safe request id
rows.body: capacity_exceeded or integrity_error,data:null; both carriers match and are validated. Re-encode and remeasure the WHOLE JSON-RPC response including result wrapper,id,both carriers.

rows.case: Even fixed fallback cannot encode/fit; no response bytes emitted yet
rows.body: Empty body; do not emit a partial result or the rejected data
Matching success operation envelope in structuredContent and JSON text; both same decoded object

rows.case: Authenticated GET or DELETE for this sessionless/no-SSE endpoint
rows.body: Empty body; Allow: POST; invalid credentials still401 before method result

carrier_invariants: isError is explicitly true on every application tool failure and false on success. Protocol errors have error and no result; transport errors have no tool carrier.
Text parses to the exact same closed envelope as structuredContent, not merely a similar message. Error envelopes always data:null and no source/citation/count/ref.
Current bearer auth is checked at final output gate even when the planned business result is already an error. Its401/503 overrides all buffered results.
The native HTTP error status map remains unchanged for native endpoints. MCP business tool results do not reuse native HTTP statuses.
No source/SQL/secret values or rejected request body may be used as protocol diagnostics. Whole-response byte guard includes JSON-RPC id; if it cannot safely be echoed use the empty503 fallback.

read_only: Only inspect/read registered; inspect catalog plus unit selector closes first read. Attempted search is unknown/unavailable tool JSON-RPC -32602,not silent search permission.
